posts.t:
Cam Talbot robs Eichel with the glove.

That is such a tough play for the goalie, when the shot misses and comes out on the other side off the end boards, but Talbot handled it well there.

Cam Talbot may be the oldest goalie in the NHL, but it doesn't stop him from challenging 3 feet outside of his crease when he doesn't sense a passing threat. 

And he still has the skating to do it, too. 

He's fun to watch.

Cam Talbot made a sensational stop on Bowman, but Tomas Hertl was right there to follow up the rebound to tie it 1-1. 

It was a great pass by Connelly to start it.
